<issue>
Gallery 布局中“显示页面图标”配置未生效
> 若为「如何使用 / 部署咨询」而非可复现缺陷，请改用 [Discussions · 使用问答](https://github.com/notionnext-org/NotionNext/discussions/new/choose)，Issue 仅用于可跟踪的 Bug。

  !!! 重要 !!!
  请遵守这个模板的格式填写，否则你的Issue将被关闭
-->

**描述bug**
首先感谢作者以及各位维护者一直以来对项目的维护与更新！

更新到最新版本后，我发现 Gallery 布局中的“显示页面图标” 配置似乎没有生效。

**期望的正常结果**
关闭 “显示页面图标” 后，网站中的 Gallery 卡片不应再显示页面图标。

**复现步骤**
1. 在 Gallery 布局 中关闭 “显示页面图标”；
2. 更新到最新版本并重新部署。

测试结果：
* Notion 中已关闭该配置；
* 网站端仍然会显示页面图标。

**环境**

- 【必填】NotionNext版本 [4.10.7]
- 【必填】主题 [hexo]
- 【必填】部署方案 [vercel]
- 【可选】操作系统: [iOS, Android, windows]
- 【可选】浏览器 [chrome, safari, firefox]

**补充说明**
我确认已经重新部署，并多次刷新页面测试，目前始终会显示页面图标，因此感觉这个配置目前可能没有生效。

如果还需要我补充更多测试信息，请告诉我，我很愿意继续配合。

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

content.text:
I hid the page icon on Gallery cards when the `POST_TITLE_ICON` setting is off. I haven't built it or run any tests, and the fix may not match what your Notion setting controls.

**What I found:** react-notion-x always draws the page icon on Gallery cards and doesn't read any Notion view setting for it. The repo had nothing to switch it off either. So the "显示页面图标" toggle in Notion can't take effect with the current renderer.

**What I changed:**
- **`components/NotionPage.js`:** the article wrapper gets a `hide-collection-card-icon` class when `POST_TITLE_ICON` is `false` or `'false'`.
- **`styles/notion.css`:** a rule hides the icon inside `.notion-collection-card` under that class.
- **`conf/post.config.js`:** the `POST_TITLE_ICON` default changed from the boolean `true` to the string `'true'`. This keeps the type the same as when it's set from an environment variable. It doesn't change behaviour by itself.

**Limits of the fix:**
- The switch is the site-wide `NEXT_PUBLIC_POST_TITLE_ICON` setting, not the per-view toggle in Notion. Turning it off in Notion still does nothing. I couldn't find a flag in the Notion view data to read it from.
- `POST_TITLE_ICON` also hides the icon in the post titles. Turning it off now hides Gallery card icons too.
- Because the config default is an env-var string, setting the variable to `false` gives the string `'false'`, which is truthy. Themes that test it directly, such as hexo's `BlogPostCardInfo.js`, would still show the icon. My Gallery check handles both forms.
